evidence_quotes.name_asked_and_used: Jeline: 'am I speaking with Rachel?' — used again as 'Rachel' at estimate and close
evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Jeline: 'this might take ten to fifteen minutes' and 'I'm gonna ask you questions regarding the move' — framing present but no explicit 'dependable quote' promise or clear wait for yes before continuing
evidence_quotes.two_concerns_question: Never asked. Jeline moved directly to 'do you have any concerns about the moving process?' — not the two-concerns script
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer raised no concern, so n/a
evidence_quotes.concern_led_opening: Jeline asked 'Are there anything heavy like equipment, safe or a piano?' and 'Anything valuable?' — but did not open with 'What items are you most concerned about?' — logistics gathered but not concern-led
evidence_quotes.packing_and_box_count: Jeline asked 'do you have an estimated number of boxes' — box count covered. Packing service (would you like us to pack?) was never asked
evidence_quotes.promises_delivered: No On-Time Guarantee or No Worries Damage Coverage mentioned at all
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Jeline stated '$208 per hour...everything is included, gas and truck taxes, insurance, all the wraps and pads' and 'no hidden fees of any type' (fee transparency + not-a-guess commitment present). Cameron's no-notes line and pricing contrast (hourly vs all-inclusive framing) were absent
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Jeline gave '$520 for two movers' as the minimum, and later '$555' for Friday — anchored but not personalized to this customer's specific concerns or prep level
evidence_quotes.value_days: Jeline mentioned 'regular rate for Friday' and noted pricing difference ($520 to $555) but did not identify the day branch, did not offer the saving as a total dollar amount in a value-day frame, and did not ask about date flexibility — partial attempt only
evidence_quotes.prep_and_temperature_check: No Save Your Ass framing about preparation being the biggest factor in move duration. No 'How do you feel about that?' temperature check with silence
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Never asked. Jeline went straight to scheduling logistics without asking 'What's still concerning you about this move?'
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_then_ask: Jeline stated 'we do not require any deposit you will only be asked to make the payment once we completed the move' (rate lock present, no deposit present) but then asked 'would you like to be on the schedule' — the ask is present but softened and muddled by the scheduling conversation that follows. Not a clean, plain 'Would you like our help with your move?'
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Date (tomorrow/Friday afternoon) and address (1600 Barton Springs Road, Austin) confirmed. Phone number, arrival window, and crew size were never confirmed. Notes for crew about concerns were not left

top_strength: Jeline gathered logistics systematically (address, floor, elevator, special items, box count) and stayed organized through a complex scenario where the customer needed unloading-only service rather than a full move.
coaching_note: Step 2 (two-concerns question) and Step 3 (both promises with lead-in) were skipped entirely — these are the bookend discovery moments that set up trust and positioning; starting with them before probing is critical to the v4 card flow.
